definitions.explanation: The mathematical operation of multiplying numbers together.

examples.japanese: {掛|か}け{算|ざん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{九九|くく}→九九：05700_kuku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{覚|おぼ}える→覚える：00739_oboeru⟧。
{掛|か}け{算|ざん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{面積|めんせき}→面積：05330_menseki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{求|もと}める→求める：02316_motomeru⟧。
examples.english: To find the area using multiplication.

notes:
{掛|か}け{算|ざん} is multiplication. Composed of ⟦{掛|か}ける→掛ける：00854_kakeru⟧ (to multiply) + ⟦{算|さん}→算：noentry⟧ (calculation).

EXPRESSING MULTIPLICATION:
- 3⟦{掛|か}ける→掛ける：00854_kakeru⟧4⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧12: 3 times 4 is 12
- 3×4=12: read as 3⟦{掛|か}ける→掛ける：00854_kakeru⟧4⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧12

MULTIPLICATION TABLE (⟦{九九|くく}→九九：05700_kuku⟧):
Japanese children learn the times table (1-9) as ⟦{九九|くく}→九九：05700_kuku⟧, reciting it rhythmically:
- 2×2=4 → {二|に}{二|に}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{四|し}
- 2×3=6 → {二三|にさん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{六|ろく}→六：00747_roku⟧

OTHER OPERATIONS:
- ⟦{足|た}し{算|ざん}→足し算：05332_tashizan⟧: addition
- ⟦{引|ひ}き{算|ざん}→引き算：05333_hikizan⟧: subtraction
- ⟦{割|わ}り{算|ざん}→割り算：05335_warizan⟧: division
